'''Ants on a log''' is a snack consisting of celery, peanut butter, and raisins. It is so-named since the raisins on the celery look similar to bugs. It is often a snack for children.

== Ingredients ==
* [[Cookbook:Celery|Celery]] stalks (enough to have 1 or 2 for each person)
* [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|Peanut butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Raisin|Raisins]]

==Procedure==
# Cut the celery up into pieces, maybe 4 or 5 [[Cookbook:Inch|inches]] (about 10-13 [[Cookbook:Cm|cm]]). This is the "log".
# Spread peanut butter on top of the celery.
# Put raisins on top. These are the "ants".

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Peanuts are a common allergen. If serving to children, check for peanut allergies.
